education.detail: LLB, Hindu Law College, Nagarjuna University

declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section in the case carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. 2 of 15 cases qualify: one involves IPC 409 (breach of trust by a public servant, max life, alongside 166/167/120B and a Prevention of Corruption Act citation); one involves IPC 302 (murder, max death/life, alongside 120B/109/34/37). The remaining 13 (public-order/trespass/mischief sections) top out under 5yr. No charges framed, zero convictions.
